plotReview: Eight original causal plots: companion cancellation before ticket payment; missing notice attachment; difficulty hearing reception calls; key discovered inside own shopping bag; apartment move within same building; obsolete mobile number alongside address update; frozen/chilled packaging comparison; companions with different walking speeds. Five tasks individually match five player turns.
serviceClaims: Simulated practice, no actual service hours, ticket machine functions, medical diagnoses, postal eligibility, bank authentication guarantees, food handling temperatures or real park geometry.
